C1412.title: Crypto Scams: 2021 Rug Pulls Push Revenues Near All-Time High
C1412.summary: A Chainalysis analysis published in December 2021 said cryptocurrency scam addresses received more than $7.7 billion from victims that year, an 81% increase from 2020. Rug pulls accounted for about $2.8 billion, or 37% of total scam revenue, compared with just 1% in 2020. The report defined rug pulls as schemes in which project developers unexpectedly abandon a project and take investors' funds, noting that the method was especially common in DeFi.
